Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation + clarifying questions

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for taking time to meet this morning. Quick recap from our discovery: AcmeHealth is evaluating a hosted inference option for patient-facing features with a pilot scope of ~5M tokens/month and a strong requirement for HIPAA controls, SOC 2 evidence, and data residency in the US. We discussed Redwood Dedicated as the likely fit for predictable throughput and isolation.

Next steps from our side: we typically start with the vendor security questionnaire so your team can validate scope and controls. I’ve attached a Redwood SIG template that covers our security, privacy, and infrastructure controls. Could you confirm whether your team prefers SIG (Excel) or the CAIQ/your custom form? Also two clarifying items from the call that would help Marissa answer follow-ups:
- HIPAA scope: is this for PHI in production or a limited subset (pilot/test data)?
- Required retention period for logs/audit evidence (in months)?

I’ve cc’d Marissa from our security team to help with SOC 2 artifacts and encryption specifics. We can turn around the filled SIG fields or map our answers into your questionnaire — whatever’s easiest for you.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Request_v1.xlsx (SIG template)

Appreciate it — happy to set a follow-up touchpoint after you’ve had a chance to review.

Best,
Camila Reyes

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation + clarifying questions

Camila —

Thanks for the recap and the SIG. We generally prefer SIG/Excel for initial passes, but we may ask you to map answers into our custom questionnaire later. A few quick clarifying questions before we start:

1) SOC 2: do you have a recent type II report? If so, can you share the latest pdf and the period covered?
2) Encryption: in-transit and at-rest — are customer keys customer-managed (KMS/HSM) or Redwood-managed for the hosted option?
3) Data residency: you mentioned US regions — do you have specific regions/providers for a hosted pilot?
4) HIPAA: pilot will include production PHI — can you confirm Business Associate Agreement (BAA) availability and any limitations?

If you can loop in security to answer or attach SOC 2, we’ll triage and start the SIG. Thanks.

—Lena
Lena Ortiz
Sr. Information Security Manager
AcmeHealth
lena.ortiz@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation + clarifying questions

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the questions — answering inline: 

1) SOC 2: Yes, we completed a SOC 2 Type II report for Security and Availability. Attached: SOC2_Report_Redwood_2026.pdf (period: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30). If you need more recent interim evidence, we can provide bridge letters and our control matrix.

2) Encryption: For Redwood Hosted, encryption in-transit uses TLS 1.2+ and at-rest uses AES-256. Customer-managed keys are available for Private and Dedicated deployments (KMS/HSM integrations). For Hosted API, we offer bring-your-own-key (BYOK) options for higher tiers — let me know if you want details and we can share our KMS integration guide.

3) Data residency: Hosted regions we commonly use are us-west-2 (AWS) and us-east-1 (AWS). Dedicated deployments can be regionalized to a single region for isolation. Private deployments (VPC) enable strict network controls and on-prem options if required.

4) HIPAA/BAA: We support BAAs for customers who require HIPAA treatment. Our standard BAA covers Redwood Hosted and Dedicated with the appropriate configuration and contractual addendum; Private on-prem deployments are handled case-by-case.

I’ve also pre-populated a few items in the attached SIG template (minor edits) to accelerate review. If you prefer, we can map answers into your custom questionnaire — please send it over and I’ll coordinate.

Attachments: SOC2_Report_Redwood_2026.pdf, Redwood_SIG_Request_v1_filled.xlsx

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
